reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of this when I paste stuff in. 59 to 99 euros a month on top of that, for something I'd have to wire into my email and CRM, is a lot when I'm not sure it does more than my current subscription.
objection: It's my customers' emails and data going through it. 'GDPR-compliant' is one line on a page; I want to know where the data is stored, who can read it, and whether it trains on it. And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, I can't tell if that's ten emails or a thousand.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually answer my real customer emails from my phone for two weeks on the free plan, with data hosted in the EU and a clear explanation of what a credit buys.
